name: Labor Residency (Employer-Sponsored Work Permit)

qualifying_event.description: A Jordanian employer secures a work permit from the Ministry of Labour for a non-Jordanian hire in a profession open to foreign workers, which then supports a Labor Residency permit from the Public Security Directorate.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Work permit issued by the Ministry of Labour; employer sponsorship.

requirements.blocker_text: Work permit issued by the Ministry of Labour, tied to a specific employer and profession.
requirements.fix_path: Secure employer sponsorship and a Ministry of Labour work permit.

requirements.blocker_text: The role must not fall on Jordan's list of professions reserved for Jordanian nationals -- the Ministry of Labour has periodically expanded this closed-professions list, restricting sectors such as some retail, clerical, and trades roles to citizens.

sources.title: Jordan Public Security Directorate (PSD), Borders and Residence Department -- Information Services: Labor Residency requires a Ministry of Labour work permit, 1-year duration, 30 JOD fee plus 1 JOD stamps
Expat Focus (relocation guide) -- Jordan work permits and working legally: closed-professions list restricting certain sectors to Jordanian nationals, employer-sponsorship structure

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Jordan). STATUS: DRAFT -- the residency-permit fee/duration mechanics are tier-1 (PSD), but the closed-professions list (which sectors are currently reserved for Jordanian nationals) is sourced only to tier-3 relocation guides after the Ministry of Labour's own comprehensive guide PDF returned a 404 in this pass -- the exact current list was not independently confirmed and is not enumerated here. work_rights is marked 'restricted' since employment is tied to the sponsoring employer and permitted profession, not open-market. pr_after_months (120) reflects PSD's stated 10-year cumulative legal residence threshold for the Five-Year Residency route (see jo_permanent_residence.json), not a confirmed work-specific pathway.
